<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1902784_refund.RefundCurrencyConverter</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>RefundCurrencyConverter</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var RefundCurrencyConverter = Class.create();
RefundCurrencyConverter.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    getUSDRate: function() {
        try {
            var apiKey = gs.getProperty('x_[scope].reimbursement.fx_api_key');

            if (!apiKey) {
                gs.error('ReimbursementCurrencyAjax: API Key não configurada.');
                return JSON.stringify({
                    success: false,
                    error: 'API Key não configurada.'
                });
            }

            var request = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
            request.setHttpMethod('GET');
            request.setEndpoint(
                'https://api.freecurrencyapi.com/v1/latest' +
                '?apikey=' + apiKey +
                '&base_currency=BRL' +
                '&currencies=USD'
            );
            request.setHttpTimeout(10000); // 10 segundos

            var response = request.execute();
            var statusCode = response.getStatusCode();

            if (statusCode !== 200) {
                gs.error('ReimbursementCurrencyAjax: HTTP ' + statusCode);
                return JSON.stringify({
                    success: false,
                    error: 'Erro HTTP: ' + statusCode
                });
            }

            var body = response.getBody();
            var parsed = JSON.parse(body);
            var rate = parsed.data && parsed.data.USD;

            if (!rate) {
                gs.error('ReimbursementCurrencyAjax: Taxa USD não encontrada na resposta.');
                return JSON.stringify({
                    success: false,
                    error: 'Taxa não encontrada.'
                });
            }

            return JSON.stringify({
                success: true,
                rate: rate
            });

        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('ReimbursementCurrencyAjax: ' + e.message);
            return JSON.stringify({
                success: false,
                error: e.message
            });
        }
    },

    type: 'RefundCurrencyConverter'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-30 12:54:49</sys_created_on><sys_id>f7c3afb583a8c35027aba6d0deaad363</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>RefundCurrencyConverter</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Refund" source="x_1902784_refund">7ef79c0d83240f1027aba6d0deaad34c</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Refund">7ef79c0d83240f1027aba6d0deaad34c</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_f7c3afb583a8c35027aba6d0deaad363</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-04-30 12:54:49</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
